title: IGNITION-136 canonical full regression runner contract

dependency_preflight.const: ignition/requirements-foundation.txt exact declared versions; no install

watchdog.const: none; outer orchestration may observe but must not kill the process

capture.const: stdout and stderr captured; optional files outside repository; sha256 always recorded

clean_tree.const: must be clean before and after; any tracked/untracked mutation is FAIL

generated_output_drift.const: reported by before/after git status; projection preflight is a separate explicit step

0.const: PASS with parsed tests, failures=0, errors=0, skips=0 and clean tree

1.const: natural unittest failure/error/skip, parse failure, or post-run tree mutation

2.const: dirty precondition, missing/mismatched declared dependency, or runner contract failure
